title: Updated: Production of Edgeware ecosystem tutorials in English and Hindi Language
body:
# Proposed Date: 5th October 2022

## Earlier we submitted the proposal for Hindi Edgeware Educational videos. However, after the community discussion, we concluded to create tutorials in both Hindi and English language. Please find the details of the proposal below:


# Edgeware DAO Proposal

> **Proponent: **n11yh9n1QXTCxMSDTYV4Vvkn3dCFJw7d5tBsLRXNkEMnYeM
> **Date: **5th October 2022
> **Requested Funds: $38,200 (USD)**
> **Short description: **Funding for the production of 40 educational tutorial videos for both Hindi and English audiences. We work on content till the Video upload date so that we can provide the latest information to our audience. 

**NOTE: We strive to provide information until it is practically proven or available on Edgeware / Polkadot official sites. We have already delivered 2 videos from this proposal in Hindi and soon English Versions will be available on our Channel i.e. DescribeDot. **


## Context of the Proposal

Hello everyone, I am Hitesh from Describedot. We create educational videos and weekly updates around the Dotsama ecosystem. We started this channel about a year ago and have already published 37 videos on our youtube channel. Our weekly viewing growth had been over 28 percent which led us to approximately 20,000 views in a year. Recently we’ve also received tremendous support from the Council Members of Polkadot and Kusama through tip endorsements. We are really thankful to the community members who supported us and assisted us in making great content.

**Regarding the Recent Video of Edgeware: First Video on Edgeware was published on 25th May, It was all about the basics of Edgeware. We got great support from the community and people showered their love through great comments as you can see below: **
